title: In Sickness and in Health: Retirement Responses to Spousal Health Shocks
title_zh: 疾病与健康：配偶健康冲击对退休决策的影响
authors: Hyeran Chung, Haena Lee, Sita Slavov
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Health shocks are a major driver of retirement. However, the existing literature on this topic tends not to consider the marital context in which retirements occur. Using the 1992-2022 Health and Retirement Study and staggered difference-in-differences methods, we investigate how spousal health shocks impact retirement transitions. We also investigate whether these effects differ by gender and health insurance status. We consider multiple definitions of health shocks, including self-reported health declines, additional diagnoses, hospitalizations, increases in out-of-pocket medical spending, and functional deterioration. Our results suggest that the probability of retirement increases by 1.2 to 1.3 percentage points (12 to 13 percent) after a spouse’s new health condition diagnosis or hospitalization. These retirements tend to occur earlier than anticipated. They also tend to be concentrated among women and respondents with employment-based health plans that include retiree coverage for their spouse.
abstract_zh: 健康冲击是退休的主要驱动因素之一。然而，现有相关文献往往未考虑退休发生的婚姻背景。利用1992-2022年健康与退休研究数据及交错双重差分法，我们探究配偶健康冲击如何影响退休转变，并分析这些效应是否因性别和医疗保险状况而异。我们采用多种健康冲击定义，包括自评健康下降、新增诊断、住院治疗、自付医疗支出增加及功能退化。结果表明，配偶新诊断健康问题或住院后，个体退休概率上升1.2至1.3个百分点（12%至13%）。这些退休往往早于预期，且主要集中在女性及拥有包含配偶退休后医疗保险的就业型健康计划的受访者中。

title: The Role of College Education in the Rise of ``New Work": Measurement and Evidence
title_zh: 大学教育在“新工作”兴起中的作用：测度与证据
authors: Gueyon Kim, Cassandra Merritt, Giovanni Peri
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a novel semantic-distance-based algorithm and apply it to job titles data to identify ``new work''---new types of jobs introduced in a labor market. Implementing these measures for the US (1980-2010), we show that the share of college-educated workers across occupations and locations is the strongest predictor of new work, even after controlling for technological change, trade, immigration, population aging, and agglomeration economies. Using pre-1920 land-grant colleges as instruments in matched treatment-control analyses, we find evidence consistent with a strong, positive causal effect of college-educated density on ``new work" creation. Complementary analysis based on Lightcast online vacancy data (2017-2022) confirms this pattern.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于语义距离的新算法，并将其应用于职位名称数据，以识别“新工作”——即劳动力市场中引入的新型职业类型。通过在美国（1980-2010年）实施这些度量，我们发现，即使在控制了技术变革、贸易、移民、人口老龄化和集聚经济等因素后，各职业和地区中受过大学教育的劳动者占比仍是新工作出现的最强预测因子。利用1920年前赠地学院作为工具变量，在匹配处理-对照分析中，我们发现了与大学教育密度对新工作创造具有强烈正向因果效应相一致的证据。基于Lightcast在线职位空缺数据（2017-2022年）的补充分析进一步证实了这一模式。

title: The Hospital Desegregation Campaign and Black Postneonatal Mortality in the Deep South
title_zh: 南方医院废除种族隔离运动与黑人新生儿后期死亡率
authors: D. Mark Anderson, K. Charles, D. Rees
abstract: In 1966, Southern hospitals were barred from participating in Medicare unless they discontinued their longstanding practice of racial segregation. Using data from five Deep South states and exploiting county-level variation in Medicare certification dates, we find that gaining access to an ostensibly integrated hospital had no effect on Black postneonatal mortality. Similarly, there is little evidence that the campaign contributed to the trend toward in-hospital births among Southern Black mothers. These results are consistent with descriptions of the hospital desegregation campaign as producing only cosmetic changes and illustrate the limits of antidiscrimination policies imposed on reluctant actors.
abstract_zh: 1966年，美国南方医院被禁止参与联邦医疗保险计划，除非其终止长期实行的种族隔离做法。利用五个深南部州的数据，并借助县级层面联邦医疗保险认证时间的差异，我们发现，获得表面整合的医院对黑人新生儿后期死亡率并无影响。同样，几乎没有证据表明这场运动促进了南方黑人母亲在医院分娩的趋势。这些结果与将医院废除种族隔离运动描述为仅带来表面变化的说法一致，并揭示了强加于不情愿行为者的反歧视政策的局限性。

title: Zero Fare, Cleaner Air? The Causal Effect of Luxembourg’s Free Public Transportation Policy on Transport Emissions
title_zh: 零票价，更清洁的空气？卢森堡免费公共交通政策对交通排放的因果效应
abstract: In March 2020, Luxembourg became the first country to make public transport free. We use this unique setting to evaluate the policy’s impact on transport emissions using a synthetic difference-in-differences framework. We use spatial emissions data to construct a panel of NUTS 2 regions in the EU from 2016 to 2022. We estimate an average reduction of 5.9% in road transport CO 2 and overall road transport GHG emissions, with larger effects for NO x . These findings are robust against confounding shifts in working from home and commuting patterns, vehicle fleet electrification, and the localized effects of the COVID-19 pandemic. Complementary event-study evidence from automatic traffic counters and air quality stations through 2023 corroborates our findings and suggests larger effects on weekends.
abstract_zh: 2020年3月，卢森堡成为首个实现公共交通免费化的国家。我们利用这一独特政策场景，采用合成双重差分框架评估该政策对交通排放的影响。通过使用空间排放数据，我们构建了2016至2022年欧盟NUTS 2区域的面板数据。研究发现，该政策使道路交通二氧化碳及整体道路交通温室气体排放平均降低5.9%，对氮氧化物的减排效果更为显著。这些结论在控制居家办公与通勤模式变化、车辆电动化进程以及新冠疫情局部影响等混杂因素后依然稳健。基于2023年自动交通计数器与空气质量监测站的补充事件研究证据进一步佐证了我们的发现，并表明该政策在周末的减排效应更为显著。

title: Plastic Dumping Grounds: The International Incidence of Environmental Regulation
title_zh: 塑料倾倒场：环境规制的国际影响
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Environmental regulations often generate environmental improvements at home, yet their consequences may extend far beyond the countries that adopt them. The international incidence of environmental regulation remains poorly understood. We study where the resulting environmental damages emerge and who ultimately bears their costs using China's 2017 ban on waste imports, which triggered a large reallocation of global recycling activity. Combining international trade data, administrative records, direct measures of firms' waste mismanagement, and local pollution data in the main destination for diverted waste, we examine the international incidence of environmental regulation by tracing the rarely observed process linking trade reallocation to firm behavior, pollution exposure, and welfare. The ban increased pollution-intensive plastic waste imports, lowering input costs for downstream firms using recyclable materials. Meanwhile, imported waste displaced domestic recyclables, leading firms to adopt harmful disposal methods. The environmental damages from air pollution exceeded the economic gains from access to lower-cost inputs.
abstract_zh: 环境法规往往能改善本国环境质量，但其影响可能远超实施国边界。目前学界对跨国环境规制效应的理解仍十分有限。本文以中国2017年实施的废品进口禁令为研究对象——该政策引发了全球回收活动的重大重组——探究由此产生的环境损害发生在何处，以及最终由谁承担其成本。通过整合国际贸易数据、行政记录、企业废弃物管理不当的直接测度指标，以及废弃物转移主要目的地的局部污染数据，我们追踪了从贸易重组到企业行为、污染暴露及福利效应的罕见传导链条，从而考察环境规制的跨国影响。研究发现：该禁令增加了污染密集型塑料废品的进口，降低了使用可回收材料的下游企业的投入成本；与此同时，进口废品挤占了国内可回收物市场，导致企业采用有害处置方式。空气污染造成的环境损害已超过低成本投入带来的经济收益。

title: At the threshold: the increasing relevance of the middle‐income trap
title_zh: 在门槛处：中等收入陷阱日益凸显的相关性
authors: Patrick A. Imam, Jonathan R. W. Temple
abstract: We investigate the existence of a middle‐income trap using finite state Markov chains, constant growth thresholds, and mean first passage times. As well as studying output per head, we examine the dynamics of its proximate determinants: total factor productivity (TFP), the capital–output ratio, and human capital. We find upward mobility in the relative capital–output ratio and human capital, but not in relative TFP. The persistence of relative TFP differences, particularly from intermediate income levels, implies slower progression toward frontier income. A middle‐income trap may therefore reflect asymmetric convergence dynamics near the frontier rather than a universal growth slowdown.
abstract_zh: 我们利用有限状态马尔可夫链、恒定增长阈值和平均首次通过时间，研究了中等收入陷阱的存在性。除了考察人均产出外，我们还分析了其直接决定因素的动态变化：全要素生产率（TFP）、资本产出比和人力资本。研究发现，相对资本产出比和人力资本呈现向上流动性，但相对全要素生产率并未如此。相对全要素生产率差异的持续性，尤其是从中等收入水平来看，意味着向前沿收入水平的进展更为缓慢。因此，中等收入陷阱可能反映了靠近前沿水平时的不对称趋同动态，而非普遍的增长放缓。

title: A Cognitive Theory of Reasoning and Choice
title_zh: 推理与选择的认知理论
authors: Pedro Bordalo, Nicola Gennaioli, Giacomo Lanzani, Andrei Shleifer
abstract: We present a theory of choice in which attention to the features of options is determined by the decision maker’s categorization of the current problem in a set of problems she solved in the past. Categorization depends on goal-relevant and contextual problem-level features. The model yields heterogeneity in attention and choice in a given problem based on different past experiences and instability when changes in irrelevant context cause re-categorization. We show that heterogeneous and unstable representations of a choice problem unify major biases in judgment and decision making.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种选择理论，其中决策者对选项特征的关注取决于其将当前问题归类于过去解决过的一组问题中的方式。分类过程依赖于与目标相关的问题层面特征及情境特征。该模型表明，在给定问题中，基于不同的过往经历会产生注意力与选择的异质性；而当无关情境的变化引发重新分类时，则会导致不稳定性。我们证明，选择问题表征的异质性与不稳定性统一了判断与决策中的主要偏差。

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Some New Monetarist Arithmetic
title_zh: 货币与财政政策：新货币主义算术
authors: Chao Gu, Randall Wright, Yu Zhu
abstract: Following Sargent and Wallace’s ‘Some Unpleasant Monetarist Arithmetic,’ we study different ways to implement monetary and fiscal policy. In one case, monetary policy pegs the path of the money supply, while fiscal policy adjusts endogenously to balance the budget. In another, fiscal policy pegs the deficit path, while money adjusts to balance the budget. We ask which is more prone to instability – i.e., more likely to have multiple equilibria, endogenous dynamics, or volatile responses to news? The answer depends on whether inflation (equivalently, the deficit) is positive or negative in the long run. This is consistent with cross-country data.
abstract_zh: 遵循萨金特和华莱士的《令人不快的货币主义算术》，我们研究了货币与财政政策的不同实施方式。一种情形下，货币政策锚定货币供给路径，财政政策内生调整以实现预算平衡；另一种情形下，财政政策锚定赤字路径，货币供给则通过调整实现预算平衡。我们探究哪种政策组合更易引发不稳定性——即更可能产生多重均衡、内生动态或对新闻的剧烈反应？答案取决于长期通胀（等价于赤字）为正还是为负。这一结论与跨国数据相吻合。
